clusters.mechanism: Service installation/restart is skipped when the preflight daemon check passes, so config written by init (new providers, merge policy) never reaches the already-running daemon.
The smoke adapter calls scripts/smoke.ts main with static PROVIDERS/MODELS and always schedules both native CLIs, ignoring the effective configured/detected providers and endpoint overrides.

Doctor's repository access/SSO check runs before init collects --repo or prompted repositories and only reads the old config, so newly requested repositories are never access-checked before being persisted.
Discreet mode is replaced by a hard-coded 'not available yet' skipped message, so init never asks for or persists the requested discreet-mode choice.
Provider diagnosis only performs a health request when healthUrl exists, so presets without one (e.g. OpenRouter) are never checked for reachability.
Candidate deduplication treats entry.preset === id as the native provider already configured, so an aliased entry with a different id suppresses adding the native preset.
